newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean feed millers buy 52,000T of feed wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean feed millers buy 52,000T of feed wheat.

text.p: South Korean feed mill companies, including Sunjin Feed Co Ltd and Jeil Feed Mill Co Ltd, on Friday bought 52,000 tonnes of feed wheat at $141.90 per tonne, C&F, traders said.
Traders said Toepfer won the contract with arrival for January 10 to the western port city of Inchon.

Origin of the wheat was set on seller's option with shipment for November 22 to December 11, if the wheat was from Europe, or for December 12-31 if it was from Canada, Australia or the Pacific Northwest. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5651
